title: Neck and shoulders, seated
intro: Six slow moves you can do without leaving your chair. Go gently and keep your breathing easy.

moves.name: Shoulder lift and drop
steps: Sit tall with your hands resting in your lap.
Lift both shoulders toward your ears, then let them drop.

moves.name: Shoulder rolls
steps: Roll both shoulders up, back and down in a smooth circle.
Switch to rolling forward halfway through.

moves.name: Gentle neck turn
steps: Look straight ahead with your chin level.
Turn your head toward one shoulder as far as feels easy.
Pause, come back, and then try the other direction.

moves.name: Ear toward shoulder
steps: Tip one ear gently toward the same shoulder, without lifting the shoulder.
Rest there for a few easy breaths.

moves.name: Chin nod
steps: Nod your chin slightly toward your chest, as if saying a small yes.
Lift back to level and repeat slowly.

moves.name: Arm hug
steps: Cross your arms in front, like giving yourself a hug.
Let your shoulders round a little and breathe out.
Open your arms wide and breathe in.

closing: That is the routine. Notice how your shoulders sit now, if you like.
wayOut: Stop if anything feels uncomfortable, and skip any move that does not suit you.
